en.quote: And I, behold, I establish My covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
en.speaker: As for Me

he.quote: וַאֲנִי הִנְנִי מֵקִים אֶת-בְּרִיתִי אִתְּכֶם וְאֶֽת-זַרְעֲכֶם אַֽחֲרֵיכֶֽם
he.speaker: וַאֲנִי

en.quote: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
en.riddle: This is the token of the covenant which I have established
en.speaker: God said

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל-נֹחַ זֹאת אוֹת-הַבְּרִית, אֲשֶׁר הֲקִמֹתִי בֵּינִי וּבֵין כָּל-בָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר עַל-הָאָֽרֶץ
he.speaker: אֱלֹהִים
